physical_anchor: Manufactures lasers, optical/photonic components and precision optics (incl. transceivers, specialty materials, cryo-compatible photonics) used in comms, industrial and quantum-sensing hardware stacks.
value_chain_position: Photonics & lasers layer of the quantum chain — supplies laser sources, optical components and specialty materials/optics that lab, testbed and comms-infrastructure builds consume regardless of which qubit modality wins.
